def verify_costas(p):
    n = len(p)
    vectors = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dc = j - i
            dr = p[j] - p[i]
            vectors.append((dr, dc))
    print(f"Permutation: {p}")
    print(f"Vectors: {vectors}")
    print(f"All distinct: {len(vectors) == len(set(vectors))}")
    print(f"x[2] = {p[2]}")
